reason: Riset mendokumentasikan karakter masquerade Carnival berupa kepala keledai kertas/bambu dan tubuh kostum di pinggul penari c04/c05/c06, bukan makhluk hidup atau manifestasi aktif. Mengubahnya menjadi makhluk keledai-manusia akan mengarang anatomi; penari berkostum biasa tidak memenuhi UjiSangar tanpa tambahan takbersumber.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
